notes: A fresh browser profile used an injected EIP-1193 test provider exposing only the stated public address and chain. Account-access permission is simulated; no real wallet ownership or authentication is proved.
Provider has no key and rejects every method except account/chain discovery and connection permission; no transaction controls were clicked.
Chain position, pool figures and borrowing arithmetic were populated by the production app using real public RPC reads, without balance or RPC-result overrides.
An initial capture showed the conservative not-live relayer message before its health probe completed. A bounded follow-up wait confirmed accepting health and sponsored-gas copy.
Range input max=1000 is a UI step scale, not MUSD; the rendered maximum was 432.78 MUSD and selected preview 300.26 MUSD.
